# Inherited template decisions

These records belong to `Daniel-T-S-Adams/AI-repo-template`. They explain why
the inherited machinery is shaped as it is — the review gate, the merge modes,
the intake — which is worth having when reconciling a template upgrade.

In a derived repository they are **not** that project's decisions and do not
share its ADR numbering. The project's own records start at `001` in
[../../adr/](../../adr/).
